Compute several thermal indices for one location

Source: R/thermify.R
thermify.Rd

Integrated workflow: (optionally) densify monthly climatologies to daily extremes, (optionally) reconstruct hourly temperatures, and compute growing degree-days, chilling hours, Utah chill units and Dynamic model chill portions with explicit accumulation periods.

Usage

thermify(
  tmin = NULL,
  tmax = NULL,
  temperature = NULL,
  input = c("monthly", "daily", "hourly"),
  dates = NULL,
  year = 2023,
  latitude = NULL,
  temporal = c("auto", "tempify", "native"),
  interpolation = "pchip_mp",
  consistency = c("check", "mean_range"),
  indices = c("gdd", "ch", "cu", "cp"),
  gdd_methods = c("average", "single_sine"),
  base = c(5, 10),
  upper = NULL,
  cutoff = "horizontal",
  ch_methods = "sine",
  ch_lower = 0,
  ch_upper = 7.2,
  hourly_method = c("linvill", "sine"),
  chill_period = c("05-01", "08-31"),
  heat_period = c("09-01", "04-30")
)

Arguments

tmin, tmax

Monthly (length 12) or daily minimum and maximum temperatures in degrees Celsius.

temperature

Hourly temperatures (degrees Celsius) when input = "hourly".

input

"monthly", "daily" or "hourly".

dates

Dates of the daily values (required for "daily" and "hourly").

year

Reference calendar year for monthly input. Default 2023.

latitude

Latitude in decimal degrees, required for the Linvill hourly model.

temporal

Densification engine for monthly input: "auto", "tempify" or "native" (see densify_monthly()).

interpolation

Densification method, default "pchip_mp".

consistency

"check" or "mean_range" (see densify_monthly()).

indices

Any of "gdd", "ch", "cu", "cp".

gdd_methods

GDD methods, see degree_days(); "hourly" uses degree_hours() on observed or reconstructed hourly temperatures.

base

Lower GDD thresholds (degrees Celsius); one result per value.

upper, cutoff

Upper GDD threshold and cutoff (see degree_days()).

ch_methods

Chilling-hours methods: "sine", "triangle" (from daily extremes) and/or "hourly" (counted on hourly temperatures).

ch_lower, ch_upper

Chilling interval (degrees Celsius).

hourly_method

Hourly reconstruction, "linvill" or "sine".

chill_period, heat_period

Accumulation windows as c("MM-DD", "MM-DD"). Defaults are southern-hemisphere conventions: chill from 1 May to 31 August, heat from 1 September to 30 April.

Value

An object of class "thermify": a list with daily (data frame of daily temperatures and index values), hourly (data frame, when hourly temperatures were used or reconstructed), summary (long data frame of seasonal, annual and monthly totals with units), config and provenance.

Input frequency

The frequency is never inferred from the number of values; set input:

  • "monthly": tmin, tmax are 12 climatological monthly means. They are densified with densify_monthly() for the reference year and treated as a closed annual cycle. Results are climatological estimates, not observations of year.

  • "daily": tmin, tmax are daily extremes on dates.

  • "hourly": temperature holds 24 * length(dates) hourly values starting at hour 0 of dates[1]. Daily extremes are taken from the hourly data, and chilling and degree-hour indices use the observations directly.

Examples

tmin <- c(11.4, 11.1, 9.2, 6.8, 5.3, 3.9, 3.1, 3.6, 4.6, 6.3, 8.4, 10.3)
tmax <- c(29.6, 29.2, 26.5, 21.9, 17.2, 13.9, 13.6, 15.3, 17.9, 21.2,
          24.9, 28.2)
res <- thermify(tmin, tmax, input = "monthly", latitude = -35.97,
                temporal = "native")
res
#> <thermify> monthly input, 365 days (climatological cycle)
#> Densification: pchip_mp via native (max |monthly mean error| = 4.4e-16 degC)
#> Hourly temperatures: linvill
#>                  key aggregation  value       units
#>       gdd_average_b5      season 2833.6    degC day
#>       gdd_average_b5      annual 3386.1    degC day
#>      gdd_average_b10      season 1623.6    degC day
#>      gdd_average_b10      annual 1663.1    degC day
#>   gdd_single_sine_b5      season 2834.8    degC day
#>   gdd_single_sine_b5      annual 3409.8    degC day
#>  gdd_single_sine_b10      season 1724.6    degC day
#>  gdd_single_sine_b10      annual 1915.4    degC day
#>              ch_sine      season 1073.9           h
#>              ch_sine      annual 1462.3           h
#>              cu_utah      season 1867.0 chill units
#>           cp_dynamic      season   81.8    portions
head(res$daily)
